Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Craig Goldstein <cdgoldstein@gmail.com>
Sent: Friday, August 16, 2019 1:21 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Baseball Prospectus Annual - Tigers Essay 
 
Not a problem! We'll have an email going out with firm deadlines and the like in a week to 10 days, but generally speaking the deadline for essays is mid-November. There is a little room for slippage there if needed, but we try to have the whole thing wrapped before the end of the year, so for drafts and edits, that's our aim.
Feel free to reach out any time with additional questions and if calling or texting works better, I'm at 301-938-0021. Thrilled to have you on board and I look forward to working with you!

On Fri, Aug 16, 2019 at 1:16 PM Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
Hey Craig,

Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner. I would love to, thank you for asking. Big fan of the annual, you guys do great work. What are the deadlines for this like? I will start coming up with some ideas.
I'm at 734-752-9667 if you need anything else from me.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Craig Goldstein <cdgoldstein@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 15, 2019 12:40:26 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Baseball Prospectus Annual - Tigers Essay 
 
Hello Anthony,

My name is Craig Goldstein and I'm the Managing Editor of Baseball Prospectus. I am reaching in hopes you might be interested in writing the essay for our BP Annual this coming offseason. If you're not familiar, the essays tend to run from 1,500-2,500 words (either end of the scale or in between is fine) and the way we like to think of the essays is: Don’t write something about the team, use the team to write about something.

I've admired your work from afar and I thought this would be a great opportunity to feature it in our annual. If you're interested, that would be great and I can follow up with additional guidelines later this month. If not, no harm done! If you have any other questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out.
